newsitem.title: USA: USX-Marathon says court rules in its favor.
newsitem.headline: USX-Marathon says court rules in its favor.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said Thursday that a federal court handed down a decision in favor of it and its subsidiaries in their lawsuit against Ruhrgas AG.
Marathon Oil is a unit of USX Corp.
The decision was made by The United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit in New Orleans on June 10, Marathon said.

The unanimous opinion said that Marathon's suit against Ruhrgas can proceed in a Texas State court for damages resulting from an alleged attempt to monopolize the western European market for natural gas, Marathon said.
Marathon said it instituted the litigation against Ruhrgas in Texas in 1995.

The lawsuit alleges that Ruhrgas and the Norwegian state-owned oil and gas company, Statoil, entered into an illicit agreement to control the production, pricing and distribution of natural gas produced in Norway, Marathon said.

After reaching this agreement, Marathon alleges that Ruhrgas and Statoil fraudulently induced Marathon to commit hundreds of millions of dollars to fund development of Norway's Heimdal field, Marathon said.
The lawsuit claims that once the field was developed, Ruhrgas refused to pay for the gas as promised and simultaneously blocked gas sales to anyone else.
Marathon said its complaint seeks return of its investment in excess of $300 million as actual damages, plus punitive damages of at least four times actual damages, plus interest.
